scope: Shared business world, branching scripted user, adapted native runner and deterministic scoring

limitations: 42 offline tests use scripted responses. One real diagnostic run is preserved separately; the 48 real baseline runs use the repaired simulator and a new frozen batch.

model_diagnostic.reason: User simulator echoed summarized answers as if they had been asked again; v2 fixes request-span parsing and save confirmation. Actor policy and cases unchanged.

runtime_preparation.note: After the diagnostic ended, unloaded and loaded the same local model with no generation. Available GPU memory then allowed full GPU residency before the main batch. No unrelated application was stopped.
